property_summary: After the current owner transfers ownership to a new owner, c.setRewardDistributor succeeds exactly when the caller is the current (new) owner and otherwise reverts leaving the distributor unchanged; the inverted onlyOwner modifier lets non-owners succeed, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Invert the require condition in the `onlyOwner` modifier so that only non-owners can call `transferOwnership`, changing who can invoke it and thus the observable owner state after calls.
